schedule_source.automated_feed_name: ESPN public NFL scoreboard schedule feed
schedule_source.secondary_validation: nflverse nfldata games.csv when 2026 rows become available

safeguards: Never infer expected_active=true solely because no injury row exists.
Never convert a missing context signal to a zero adjustment.
Every context signal must retain source and capture timestamp.
Sportsbook, odds and implied-probability content is prohibited from football ingestion.
Automated schedule rows must be 2026 regular-season events and are labeled with their source; NFL.com remains the authoritative schedule cross-check.
